_comment: Variant warnings and notes per model regex. Each note cites its source.

notes.text: Two hardware-different boards are sold as JC1060P470 with DIFFERENT PINOUTS: JC1060P470C_I_W = yellow PCB, no case, bare ESP32-P4 + separate ESP32-C6 module; JC1060P470C_I_W_Y = black case, JC-ESP32P4-M3 module (P4 + C6), Ethernet, RS-485 and a 2×13 pin header. Use the matching archive (JC1060P470C_I_W.zip vs JC1060P470C_I_W_Y.zip).
notes.sk: Pod označením JC1060P470 sa predávajú dve hardvérovo odlišné dosky s iným pinoutom: JC1060P470C_I_W (žlté PCB bez krytu) a JC1060P470C_I_W_Y (čierny kryt, modul JC-ESP32P4-M3, Ethernet, RS-485, 2×13 pin header).

notes.text: Newer panels (2026+, V2 mark or panel date code ≥ 2622) still use the JD9165 driver but with a different init sequence/timing; the wrong one gives a white screen with a vertical noise band.

This family is the '7" ESP32-P4 HMI, 1024×600, MIPI-DSI' Guition board from the request. The '60 FPS' claim was not found on guition.com; community timing analysis computes ≈60 Hz (dtsi timings) / ≈65 Hz (vendor example).

ESP32-P4 silicon before rev 3 and rev 3 are not binary compatible; a 10150002-V3 board revision with rev3 silicon exists. ESP32-C6 ships with old ESP-Hosted slave firmware (2.3.0) – upgrade to 2.12.x for stable Wi-Fi.
guition.com links the same development archive (JC4880P443C_I_W.zip) for the _Y (cased) version.
